messages:
ana-ml: quick summary — ran longform (8k) repeat-pass bench for Llama/Mistral/Qwen across h100 / mi300 / a100 in us-east, eu-west, apac-sin. looking at p50/p95, and kernel fallthrough rates when we force rope-rewind + GQA on quant4x. plots attached (see links).

miles: nice. what does 'rope-rewind' mean here? is it the rewind-on-cache-miss change we rolled last week?

ana-ml: typo, sorry — ana-ml. yes, rope-rewind = rewinding KV cache when sequence chunk boundaries cross for longform continuation. we enabled the new rewind-path in runtime to avoid stale KV reuse. metric of interest: p95 spike and kernel-fallthrough %.

miles: paste p95 numbers?

ana-ml: sure — quick table from the run:```
model   gpu    region    p50(ms)   p95(ms)   fallthrough%
Llama   h100   us-east   42        210       1.2
Llama   mi300  us-east   55        310       3.5
Llama   a100   us-east   60        380       5.9
Mistral h100   eu-west   38        195       0.9
Mistral mi300  eu-west   50        265       2.8
Qwen    h100   apac-sin  45        230       2.1
Qwen    mi300  apac-sin  58        340       6.4
```

devon: wow a100 p95 is high for Llama. is that with quant4a?

ana-ml: yes all runs used 4-bit mixed quant (quant4a for Llama, quant4b for Qwen where supported). we also ran a control set full-fp16 — p95 dropped ~12-18% on mi300/h100 but cost skyrockets. main takeaway: kernel fallthrough correlates with p95; when the optimized rope kernel isn't selected we hit a slower fallback path (interleaved CPU ops).

sophia: any regional diffs beyond raw latency? like tail sensitivity from cross-rack routing?

ana-ml: eu-west had overall lower tail for Mistral (we tuned kernel selection there earlier). apac-sin had higher fallthrough on mi300 for Qwen — likely driver/kernel mismatch and our quant kernel not compiled for that image. infra-bot flagged mismatched kernel-abi on 2 mi300 nodes during run :warning: (see infra-bot logs).

infra-bot: ACTION: node mi300-12-eu had kernel-abi mismatch, auto-fallback to generic-kernel at 2043218896. repro: /srv/logs/bench/2043218888/mi300-12-eu.log

rachel-qa: from quality side, we ran LM-eval harness on a 2k prompt slice. no major generation regressions vs fp16 for Llama/Mistral; Qwen showed slight coherence drop on one synthetic repetition test when quantized + rope-rewind enabled. filing follow-up eval.

miles: recommendations?

ana-ml: short: prefer h100 for mixed longform workloads if cost allows; mi300 needs image rebuild with kernel-abi fixed for quant kernels in apac; A100 is okay but higher p95 with our current batching strategy. Ops: for capacity sizing, use p95 budgets: h100 ~ 200ms, mi300 ~ 320ms, a100 ~ 380ms at our target 8k tokens sim qps. Also add runtime flag to prefer rope-optimized kernel and avoid fallback for hot routes.

devon: can we gate rope-rewind on model/time-window until kernel fixes are deployed in apac? safer to avoid tail spikes for prod customers.

ana-ml: agree. will open rollout PR to default rope-rewind off in apac-mi300, and include a canary in eu/h100. PR link: https://git.redwood/inf/runtime/pulls/5342

miles: link to the perf plots?

ana-ml: perf plots + raw CSV: https://s3.redwood/perf/2043218888-longform-run.tar.gz

sophia: thanks. I'll coordinate with infra to schedule image rebuilds and add a health-check for kernel-abi on startup.

rachel-qa: I'll add the Qwen regression to eval-suite and pin a test for synthetic repetition coherence.

miles: ack. short follow-up: for cost optimization we should also try small-token-chunking (1k chunk size) to reduce fallthroughs — might increase compute but reduce tail. can someone run 1k chunk slice next?

ana-ml: queued — next run w/ 1k chunks on h100 + mi300 in us/eu, ETA ~1.5h. will post results in this thread. :rocket:
